# @aponiajs/store-redis

> Redis storage adapters for AponiaJS distributed cache, rate limit, session, idempotency, and auth token stores.

## Exports

- `RedisCacheStore`: implements `CacheStore`
- `RedisRateLimitStore`: implements `RateLimitStore`
- `RedisSessionStore`: implements `SessionStore`
- `RedisIdempotencyStore`: implements `IdempotencyStore`
- `RedisRevocationStore`: implements `RevocationStore`
- `RedisRefreshTokenStore`: implements `RefreshTokenStore`
- Types: `RedisClientInterface`, `RedisStoreOptions`
